name: ShipBoost

sources.title: Homepage — weekly launch board + permanent listings; 'Submit your product' links to signup flow
Pricing — Free Launch $0 forever (one week on launchboard, permanent listing, 'Verified ShipBoost badge required'); Premium $9-19/launch adds editorial article + guaranteed dofollow

conditions: Free Launch requires displaying a 'Verified ShipBoost badge' on your site (reciprocal badge gate)
Sign-in required — 'Sign in' in nav; submission flow is behind an account
requirements: Bootstrapped SaaS / product launches — positioned for founders
Free tier: one week on the launchboard plus a permanent public listing indexed in category and tag pages
Premium ($9-19/launch one-time): reserved launch week, featured placement, hand-written editorial article, guaranteed dofollow links
'Approved tools only' noted on pricing page — submissions are reviewed
preparation: Product name, URL, one-line tagline, category (Marketing/Sales/Analytics/Support/Productivity/Development/AI/Commerce/Product)
Logo image for the product card
Ability to embed their 'Verified ShipBoost badge' on your site for the free tier
workflow: Create an account / sign in at shipboost.io
Open 'Submit your product' (/submit), complete the listing form with logo, tagline, category
For the free tier, add the required Verified ShipBoost badge to your site
After approval the product enters the weekly Launch Pad board and gets a permanent listing
Optional: upgrade to Premium for a reserved week + editorial article + dofollow
watchFor: Free listing's dofollow status is not promised — only Premium guarantees dofollow
Badge requirement makes 'free' effectively a link exchange
Heavy reciprocal-badge ecosystem — evaluate whether association fits brand
Aggressive ad upsells ($29-$59/30 days) and a paid directory-submission partner offer
Founding Premium price ($9) is seat-limited (50 spots)
countsAsLive: Product appears on shipboost.io Launch Pad board or a /products/<slug> listing page linked from category/tag indexes
unknowns: Whether free listings are nofollow by default
Badge verification mechanics (do they crawl for it?)
